name: Path-aware independent code-owner review

attribution.legal_posture: This is analyst-applied defensive context derived from generic first-party product documentation; it describes controls. Incident attribution, actor finding, legal allegation, adjudication, and measured effectiveness require separate evidence.

caveats: Account, handle, repository, portfolio, commit, and image similarity identify evidence types; legal identity requires source-explicit linkage or authoritative corroboration.
Keep fake-interview malware separate from fraudulent employment unless a source explicitly connects the same account or operator to both activities.

Present this as a general control. Reviewers should be independent of the candidate or new hire; account labels require evidence that reviewers are distinct human operators.
Preserve provider caveats and label first-party product descriptions as provider claims rather than independently measured efficacy.

statements: GitHub and Bitbucket document code-owner mappings that route changed paths to designated reviewers; GitHub can require code-owner approval before merge.
limitations: Present as a general control. Require reviewers independent of the candidate or new hire; account labels alone do not prove that reviewers are distinct human operators.
